name: Intro description

name: Description signal
text: Our take on the table lamp. A generous shade, a warm downward glow, and just enough presence to make a corner feel like a place.

name: About story
text: We started with a simple thought: the nicest part of the day doesn’t need much. Something on the table, someone on the other side, and light that lets you settle in.

name: About closing
text: SOFT SIGNAL is a small world of portable lamps. Familiar shapes, useful details, and no reason to sit near a socket.

name: Support answer 0
text: Charge with the included USB-C cable and a 5V USB power adapter. Unplug once charged. Wipe the powder-coated surface with a soft, dry cloth; skip abrasive cleaners and soaking.

name: Support answer 1
text: Use your lamp indoors or on a dry, covered balcony. Bring it back inside after use. These lamps are not waterproof and should stay away from rain, pools, and damp surfaces.

name: Support answer 2
text: This is a fictional storefront concept. Shipping zones, delivery dates, return terms, and contact details will be set by the merchant before launch. The review checkout does not take payment or place an order.

name: Support answer 3
text: Every lamp includes a USB-C charging cable and care card. The “With dock” option adds a matching charging dock. A USB power adapter is not included.

name: Finale description
text: Bring a little good light along.

name: Footer tagline

For no particular occasion.
